context:
Goal: the phone app's step 4 screens pass their accessibility checks, so step 4 can ship.
Problem: two checks on the Orphaned card-entry screen fail only on the iPhone keyboard's word-suggestion bar, which Apple draws, not us. Item 19 covered only our own named buttons, so this needs your word.
Based on: the 14:00 full test run, 71 tests: these 2 fail only on Apple's suggestion cells (measured).
Based on: your item 19 ruling, a skip for named elements only (ruling).
Meanwhile: Restyle adds the missing names the Edit button needs for item 19's skip. That third failure is ours, and it's being fixed.
holds: Step 4's two composer accessibility checks can't pass, so step 4 can't merge.

options.gain: The checks pass, and our views are still fully checked with the keyboard up.
options.how: In the two card-entry checks only, ignore problems on the keyboard's suggestion bar. Every check on our own screens stays on.
options.label: Skip Apple's keyboard in these two checks
options.lose: The check stops reporting on Apple's keyboard, which we can't change anyway.

options.how: The test hides the keyboard, then runs the check.
options.label: Close the keyboard before checking
options.lose: The check no longer sees the screen the way you use it, with the keyboard up.

ref: item 19 (your narrow skip for named elements); step 4 full suite on step4-polish 87e88fe
title: The accessibility check fails on Apple's keyboard suggestion bar. Skip it there?
why: It keeps checking the real screen, and skips only what Apple draws.
